rules: Place exactly one queen in every row.
Place exactly one queen in every column.
Place exactly one queen in every lettered region.
Two queens must not touch, including diagonally adjacent cells.
Long diagonals are allowed: this is regional Queens, not chess N-Queens.
There is exactly one complete solution. Rows and columns are numbered from 1.
state.instruction: The given queen is certified part of the unique complete solution. Keep it fixed; choose one additional queen cell from the options. No other queens are placed yet.

pick.instructions: Select ANY additional cell that does not conflict with the given queen in row, column, region, or touching. Only immediate pairwise legality is required, not eventual completion. More than one option may be locally legal.
